accepted_basis.separation_note: Three kinds of evidence are deliberately kept apart and must not be conflated. SOFTWARE-CI evidence says the delivered code passes its own authoritative gate on disposable databases. LIVE evidence says that same code, deployed to a real development appliance, behaved as specified with every flag OFF. The PRODUCT-OWNER DECISION is neither: it is the judgement that the two together are sufficient for LIVE-DARK maturity, and it was taken by the Product Owner, not by the implementer.

zero_product_runtime_change.claim: The acceptance and closure round changes no product-runtime file.
zero_product_runtime_change.measurement: git diff --name-only between the accepted delivery/evidence head 4142f5fe857787a745b186d8ac38edaad7b4d268 and the closure delivery head returns no path under data-plane/, hotel-admin/, scripts/ or .github/workflows/. Only governance/, docs/, exports/ and two governance validators under tools/ change: validate-current-state-parity.py gains the Phase-5 plan in its phase-plan map so the accepted-phase-semantics rule actually reads that surface, and validate-project-state.sh learns the post-closure next action, because an unrecognised next action is supposed to fail rather than pass quietly.
zero_product_runtime_change.why_it_is_measured_and_not_asserted: An acceptance round is exactly the moment at which a quiet code change is least likely to be noticed, because attention is on the paperwork. The proof is derived from Git.
zero_product_runtime_change.scope_note: 'Product runtime' means the software the appliance runs and the gates that build it: data-plane/, hotel-admin/, scripts/ and .github/workflows/. Governance validators under tools/ are not product runtime, and the one change there is named explicitly above rather than hidden inside a broader claim.

accepted_limitations.subject: POST_STAY_ACTIVE has no exit transition
accepted_limitations.statement: The FINAL contract draws no arrow out of POST_STAY_ACTIVE. A reinstatement for a converted Stay is refused by p3_stay_lifecycle_guard and lands in the operator queue. Recorded and tested as F8-i; the Product Owner confirmed the transition must not be invented in this phase.

accepted_limitations.subject: Post-Stay v1 is zero-price only
accepted_limitations.statement: A priced or settlement-requiring revision is REFUSED rather than granted free. Paid post-stay access remains outside this phase and requires a separate future authorization.

accepted_limitations.subject: post-stay requires a device authorized during the stay
accepted_limitations.statement: Verification derives its candidate profiles from the device's own authorization lineage, so a wholly new device receives the uniform non-success. This is what removes the client-supplied-subject parameter altogether, and it is a deliberate trade rather than a gap to close silently.

accepted_limitations.subject: stay_links(reason='POST_STAY') is never written
accepted_limitations.statement: Both of its ends are NOT NULL Stays and post-stay has one, so writing it would require synthetic PMS state. Enforced by the database guard; the enum value stays reserved and unused.

accepted_limitations.subject: a transfer is not reversible by an inverse transfer
accepted_limitations.statement: The source entitlement is terminated and from_entitlement_id is UNIQUE. Reversal is an operator/PMS-level correction, not a Phase-5 capability.

accepted_limitations.subject: the destination grant is a bounded window
accepted_limitations.statement: A transfer grants a bounded window at the destination rather than an open-ended entitlement. This is the delivered behaviour and is not to be read as an equivalence between source and destination access.

accepted_limitations.subject: several Phase-3/Phase-4 integration tests are not repeatable against a reused database
accepted_limitations.statement: They count across the whole database rather than their own site. Two were fixed; the rest are unchanged. CI builds a fresh database per run, which is the documented contract; re-engineering those suites was outside D21.

accepted_limitations.subject: cmd/scd integration tests need migrations 0001-0006
accepted_limitations.statement: The local Phase-5 harness does not build them, so those tests run in CI, which builds the full chain. The local harness is scoped to the Phase-5 surface deliberately.

accepted_limitations.subject: four pmsd DARK-contract arms were proven at the predicate level, not end-to-end
accepted_limitations.statement: The restart-storm, journal-statement, process/socket-footprint and database-backend arms were demonstrated by running the same expressions against real appliance data that violates them, rather than end-to-end through the deployment script, because no enabled-and-inactive substitute unit exists on the development appliance and manufacturing one would have meant installing a unit on it. The installed/enabled and clean-disabled-exit arms were proven end-to-end. Recorded rather than claimed as a full end-to-end negative proof.
